The '''TransGalMeg Industries Conference Center''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Toggeus]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sahreel]] went to the facility in an effort to take custody of [[Crying Dawn Singer]] from [[Braig Farool]], only to learn that the [[Shashay]] was being held in the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]] on the other side of the planet.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
